title: Catalogue row, format 1
description: One book of catalogue.tsv.xz (scripts/build-catalogue.py writes it; app/.../Catalogue.kt reads it), after the tab-separated columns are split by x-column-order. FROZEN: released files may only gain optional properties; see docs/data-specs.md. Format 1 had no rating columns.

id.description: Project Gutenberg book number; the EPUB is https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/<id>.epub3.images

title.description: First line of the title, at most 80 characters, no tab or newline.

authors.description: "Last, First" names joined with "; "; empty when the feed names none.

downloads.description: Gutenberg's download count for the book.

tags.description: Positions in the file's tag line (line 2), most used tag first; empty cell is no tags.
